understanding.description: What the task asks for, in your own words

findings.description: Relevant facts from the code; for a bug, its root cause

steps.description: The concrete changes to make, in order

risks.description: What could break or needs attention

questions.description: Questions that must be answered before implementing; empty if none

options.description: 2 to 4 short likely answers the requester can pick with one tap, each at most 40 characters

decisions.description: Choices you made yourself that the requester may want otherwise; empty if none

text.description: The choice, as a short question

chosen.description: What the plan assumes, at most 40 characters

alternatives.description: 1 to 3 other answers the requester can pick with one tap, each at most 40 characters
